lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Platforms are firm. Reeds are not. The difference is about a metre either side and about your whole life, so walk where the boards are and nowhere else.

lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Everything the Basin ever washed down comes out here eventually. Twenty years of it, turning up a piece at a time. Good salvage. Bad walk.

lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: And things come out of that water that look like people you knew. Don't answer them. I answered one, once, and I'd take it back.
